workflow_disposition.interpretation: The benchmark completed, emitted WAVE4_DECISION=PARTIAL, wrote a full report, and uploaded the artifact. A copied launcher receipt assertion referenced a metric not emitted by Wave 4. No second scientific run is authorized or needed.

hard_reject_diagnostic.observed_pattern: All three rejected normalization payloads were otherwise grounded CLAIM objects that omitted the requested confidence field.
hard_reject_diagnostic.conclusion: Do not change the normalization schema in the next wave because that would confound proposal-selection isolation; retain and measure the same strict guard.

residual_localization.evidence: All available exact propositions improve teacher-source mean F1 from the Wave-2 region control 0.274 to 0.319.
Qwen-selected propositions fall to mean teacher-source F1 0.215, below both the Wave-2 region control and the 0.319 available-proposition ceiling.
residual_localization.conclusion: Replace Qwen proposal selection before changing normalization.

residual_localization.evidence: Using the unchanged research query and existing BM25 scoring, choosing the highest-scoring complete proposition per selected region yields teacher-source mean F1 0.303 and page-equal best matches for all six preserved teacher claims.
residual_localization.conclusion: Use deterministic BM25 proposition selection as the next bounded experiment.

residual_localization.evidence: Final normalized teacher agreement fell to 0.178 because the proposal selector supplied weak propositions; normalization cannot be adjudicated independently from this Wave-4 result.
residual_localization.conclusion: Wave 5 should improve only proposal selection while keeping normalization fixed.
